results.title: Artifact (app) - Wikipedia
results.snippet: Artifact was a personalized social news aggregator app that uses recommender systems to suggest articles. Launched in January 2023 by Nokto, Inc., a company founded by co-founders of Instagram Kevin Systrom and Mike Krieger, the app was available for iOS and Android.

results.title: Artifact news app is shutting down, one year post-launch by Instagram founders | Mashable
results.snippet: Despite early appreciation from news professionals and users alike, it appears Artifact couldn't beat the quick churn of popular social media sites — and the increasingly inevitable trailing off of AI buzz.

results.title: What happened to Artifact? | TechCrunch
results.snippet: New data indicates that Artifact couldn’t catch up to the competition and struggled to grow its user base outside the U.S. It also saw downloads of the app steeply dropping off after launch, indicating a failure to catch on with a more mainstream audience. In a company blog post, Instagram and Artifact co-founder Kevin Systrom had explained that the decision to shut down the app came about because they realized the market opportunity wasn’t large enough to warrant continued investment.

results.title: Why Artifact Failed
results.snippet: Struggle to expand: They failed to catch a more mainstream audience and gain an international following.

results.title: Artifact, Instagram founders’ News app, to shut down next month
results.snippet: Systrom said that the decision to shut down Artifact was not an easy one, but it was necessary to avoid wasting resources and time on a product that did not have a clear future.
